Name: Mole Playing Rough Coop Animal SNES
Author: StardewBlaster
Description:
Adds Mole Playing Rough as a coop animal. Digs up clay and various geodes, increasing in quality with friendship.

(Each heart in animal social menu is 200 Friendship Points)
-100 Friendship: Geode
-400: Frozen Geode
-600: Magma Geode
-800: Omni Geode
-980: Artifact Trove
 Begins producing more per day at 500 friendship.

Costs 400g and available from start but takes awhile to produce much of value.
Can produce a fistful of artifact troves in a day at max friendship however.

For whatever reason cannot get it to dig up more than 1 type of geode per day. If you know how to do this let me know.
Please report any bugs.
